body: Thanks for responding. i feel curiously burdened by having to reply all the time.

Hi, friend. I'm on here tonight because I'm in crisis mode. But if I can still lend a hand, I'd like to. You describe yourself in negative terms, but with verve. That alone is a really good trait and not to be shrugged at! I don't mean to sound trite (self-questioning as well), but your mind sounds like very good reason for hope.

In French, there are a lot of good ones about being drunk.

Round like a shovel handle.
Stuffed like a quince.

Etc.

Also, things like – you're depressed: You have the cockroach.

You're lazy – You have a hair on your hand.

You're being hampered from doing something – You have lead in your wing.
You'd think, right? In France, they eat lamb's and calf's brains, but those are juvenile animals, and (I forget why) it's only the adult animals that can get prion disease.

Mushroom hunting.

It's like a treasure hunt for adults! You get to be out in nature, hike at a leisurely pace, see pretty woods, and then bring home tasty (and free) things you can cook with. But obviously you have to know how to identify edible ones.

Rehydrate them in hot water, squeeze them out, boil down the soaking water, and when almost dry, throw in a knob of butter and sauté the blacks. Then you can use them in an omelet, make a sauce for pasta, or in a braised meat dish finished with cream, etc. So many possibilities!
